selection.sequence_rule: owner historical maximum production_sequence plus one; choose the opposite tone of the previous saved choice

classification.frozen_from: actual final video QA and approved complete package

warehouse.missing_category: leave slot empty; do not substitute the other category

legacy.frozen_projects_and_packages: Preserve body/template/approvals; explicit2026-10-24 V6 technical tail replacement applies to all unpublished packages. Published originals remain immutable.
legacy.historical_random_selection: readable and recoverable; no longer the default for new production

scope: Policy and source identity record; deployment, actual media acceptance and platform submission require their own real receipts.

duration.measurement_basis: Current complete retained measured narration timeline plus the exact bound original outro and any other fixed occupancy; use actual frames/durations, never estimated word count, nominal storyboard seconds or an earlier untreated recording instead.
duration.over_60_through_70: reuse complete existing narration in the normal queue; pitch-preserving additional body tempo fit to a complete final result at most 60 seconds; do not additionally shorten the approved script
duration.above_70: existing script-shortening and renewed review workflow
duration.extra_tempo_formula: measured_body_seconds / (60 - exact_fixed_seconds), using actual frame/packaging constraints so the final complete file passes <=60 seconds
duration.frozen_warehouse_packages_and_published_: Warehouse: owner-authorized V6 tail-only derivative, same body/copy approval and FIFO. Published works: preserve, no republication.
